notes.text:
This update for busybox fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2023-42366: heap buffer overflow in the `next_token` function of `editors/awk.c` (bsc#1217586).
- CVE-2026-38752: stack buffer overflow in the `evaluate()` function of `editors/awk.c` (bsc#1271544).
- CVE-2026-38753: use-after-free in the `awk_sub()` function of `editors/awk.c` (bsc#1271545).
- CVE-2026-38754: heap buffer overflow in `ifsbreakup()` function of `shell/ash.c` (bsc#1271547).
- CVE-2026-38755: heap buffer overflow in `evalcommand()` function of `shell/ash.c` (bsc#1271548).
